title: Truss Forge
description: Engineer a bridge across a canyon with wood, steel and cable trusses, then send a truck across to test if it holds.
concept: A structural-engineering sandbox: drag between nodes and anchors to place beams from three materials with different cost, strength and tension behavior. Switch to Test Drive and a physics simulation runs a real Verlet-integrated truss — beams flex, show live stress-color feedback, and snap if overloaded while a truck crosses. Three canyon widths raise the difficulty, and a running cost meter turns every build into an optimization puzzle.
features: Build mode: drag-to-connect beam placement across wood/steel/cable materials with live cost tracking
Physics-driven Test Drive: Verlet truss simulation with per-beam stress coloring and breakage
3 canyon difficulty levels with independent best-score leaderboard
Save/load named designs, JSON export/import, PNG export, and shareable URL-hash links
Undo/redo history and localStorage autosave of the current bridge

interaction.mouse: Drag between nodes/anchors to place a beam; click empty space to add a node
interaction.click: Toolbar switches mode, material, canyon level, and triggers Test Drive / exports
interaction.touch: Same drag-to-connect gesture via unified Pointer Events, snap-to-grid for precision
